chunks: "Fasting on the Day of Tarwiyah is an expiation for one year, and fasting on the Day of Arafah is an expiation for two years."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.صَوْمُ: fasting; abstaining in worship for the sake of Allah
key_terms.كَفَّارَةُ: expiation; that by which sins are effaced
key_terms.يَوْمِ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of Arafah, the ninth day of Dhu al-Hijjah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for fasting on the Day of Tarwiyah and the Day of Arafah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward of fasting on two distinguished days connected with hajj: the Day of Tarwiyah and the Day of Arafah. It presents these fasts as a means of expiation, showing the spiritual merit of voluntary fasting on sacred occasions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1807 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Fasting on the Day of Tarwiyah is an expiation for one year, and fasting on the Day of Arafah is an expiation for two years."
